notes.kiongozi: Plural: viongozi, but it agrees like a person: kiongozi wetu.

guidebook.intro: Community runs deep: neighbours raise money together, meetings are long and everyone has a say.

tips.title: Each other: -ana
body: Replace the last **-a** with **-ana** and the action goes both ways: **-penda** (love) → **-pendana** (love each other), **-saidia** → **-saidiana** (help each other), **-ona** → **-onana** (see each other).
You’ve known one since Unit 1: **Tutaonana**, “we will see each other”.

culture.title: Harambee
body: **Harambee** (“let’s all pull together”) is Kenya’s national motto. A harambee is a community fundraiser for a school, a hospital bill or a student’s fees, where everyone gives what they can.
